author: asukhobo
title: Debian Packages test fails - apt-get cannot connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com
signature: could not connect to azure archive ubuntu com connection refused|Network

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get install fails: Connection refused to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80

key_errors: E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/... Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (52.250.76.244). - connect (111: Connection refused)
E: Unable to fetch some archives, maybe run apt-get update or try with --fix-missing?
root_cause: The Azure Ubuntu archive mirror (azure.archive.ubuntu.com) became unreachable during the apt-get install step in the Debian Packages job. After multiple retries (~4 minutes of retrying), all package downloads failed with 'Connection refused' on port 80. This is a transient network/infrastructure failure on the Azure-hosted Ubuntu package mirror — not related to any code changes in PR #37393. Run attempt 2 was automatically triggered and is currently in progress.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure on Azure infrastructure, not reproducible locally
recommended_actions: Wait for run attempt 2 to complete (already in progress)
If attempt 2 also fails, re-add the PR to the merge queue manually
prevention_strategies: Add apt-get retry logic with fallback mirrors in Debian package job. Consider using apt-get with --retry or mirrors.ubuntu.com fallback.
historical_context: Network failures to azure.archive.ubuntu.com are a known transient infrastructure issue on GitHub Actions Azure runners.
